# Third-party promotional badge

`itunes-store-small-badge.svg` is the unmodified Apple-provided Small Badge, exported at4× resolution for Android without altering its artwork. It is displayed at79.25×16dp inside an88×48dp touch target, with clear space. The guidelines explicitly allow this variant alongside titles in a list. The earlier `itunes-store-badge.svg` is retained as a source asset but is no longer the runtime badge. It is not Yono Music's logo. Apple marks remain Apple's property and are used only next to the promoted store content and direct store links.

Official source/guidelines: https://www.apple.com/itunes/marketing-on-itunes/identity-guidelines.html
Archive: https://www.apple.com/105/media/us/ipoditunes/itunes/2018/3a5387c5_1ebd_4993_9633_ff7264dc27bf/itunes-store-badges/us_uk.zip
Current member: US_UK/Small_Badge/iTunes_Store_Small_Badge_RGB_012318.svg
Previous large member: US_UK/iTunes_Store_Badge/Buy_on/SVG/US_UK_iTunes_Store_Buy_Badge_RGB_011818.svg
Usage: https://performance-partners.apple.com/search-api

The Apple badge/marks are not relicensed under the application's open-source license. No preview audio or remote album-cover runtime assets are bundled. Documentation screenshots show the actual catalogue UI during verification. Apple previews are streamed for individual store discovery, not exported, saved, auto-playlisted or used to promote another service's downloads.
